verdict.rationale: Metorial publishes its platform source on GitHub, so users can read it. However, the platform LICENSE is the Functional Source License (FSL-1.1-ALv2), a source-available license that only converts to Apache 2.0 later. Only the Catalog is under Apache 2.0 today, so 'open license' holds only in part, even though a community user calls it 'fully open source'. Missing for 10: an OSI-approved open license on the core platform now rather than a delayed Apache conversion, and documentation explaining which components fall under which license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
